answer: Expiry is enforced by the contract clock, and renewal needs a fresh signature. Grants are issued as short-lived sub-keys that expire within the epoch. A stolen sub-key dies within minutes, so 90 fakes need 90 fresh grants, not one theft. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the lantern signal is public, the horizon check is automatic, and 90 aliases cost 90 times what one real agent costs, with the pigment trail open to all.
